title: Two cyclic fields with accelerated cube and oriented removals

claims.statement: The explicit 2-field degree-500 cyclic encoder with extended quadratic-residue parity and its radius-113 depth-budget list decoder on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 13793812699701584233989266086719410691211/250000000000000000000000000000000000000000.

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR profiles, field, orbits and primitive bound (0), averaged pair bounds at cutoffs 212–224 (1), remaining pair bounds and child removal counts (2), and complete occupancy and error (3). The cumulative score check uses the exact oriented proper-run bounds. Part zero also checks the wide-window cube schedule, extended RAM map and fixed-cap worst-case recurrence, with eight exact reference-counter replays.
